text: Reception reported 91 of 183 rooms occupied on 21 Nov (49.7%), 43 of them Rabdan, unchanged from 20 Nov, with 0 check-ins and 0 check-outs. Reception logged 3 new inquiries, 2 viewings and 1 booking confirmation; renewals 0 confirmed and 0 pending. All 5 guest complaints received were closed.
Reports for 21 Nov received from Operations, Reception, Maintenance, Accounts, HR & Admin, the Flower shop and AJ1881. The IT and Housekeeping reports were not seen.

ADNOC (50 premium rooms) and the Ras Al Khaimah client are being handed over from Operations to Accounts; neither has confirmed yet. Reception trainees contacted 25 real estate and travel agencies, with 5 interested. AJ1881 sold AED 174 from 9 covers, all beverages, busier in the evening; the flower shop recorded no sales and sent corporate proposals to several offices.

Maintenance completed 7 jobs on 21 Nov, including painting of basements B1–B4 and the B1 guest lift lobby, a room 808 AC and wash-basin fix, a room 1204 drawer and a 10th-floor FCU leak. Still pending: the room 706 thermostat, basement parking lights and the rooftop calorifier and gas boiler leak, where vendor inspection results are awaited. Operations asked for a full maintenance and equipment status report.
Operations sent Madam three elevator AMC quotations (Ever Gravity, Lift Dubai Company, Circle Elevator & Escalator) and recommended approval as a priority for safety and continuity.

For Oui Cafe, Operations met a carpenter on a new kiosk and photo booth, ran a grab-and-go chef trial, had signage measured for Blumont and Samha and followed up the outdoor seating; the Al Khayam quotation is still pending. BCT Flowers sent its supplier registration documents to Sirius Holdings.

Accounts put the basement storage rooms under the Maintenance In-Charge’s control, with a full inventory set for Monday 23 Nov, and verified the updated tenant list with Reception. HR again lists offer letters and visa processing pending for 6 staff.

Awaiting decision: the elevator AMC, the facility management AMC proposal, room 710 FCU rewinding, the lobby partition concern, the MBG accounting and VAT proposal, the AJ1881 rename and supplies purchase, the Pilates studio start and housekeeping, the final driver selection, and pending offer letters and visa processing.
